scope: single-layer TP2 rank-local MLP partial output before all-reduce
quality_scope: local numerical comparison on the recorded input, full-model quality requires evaluation
timing_scope: both linears, BF16 SwiGLU and candidate activation quantization, preloaded weights/input

timing.order: Exact arm order is recorded in every shape's rounds
timing.wall: perf_counter enclosing event records, full chain and device synchronize
timing.device: NPU event elapsed time around the full chain on the current stream

memory.scope: process allocator during warmed timing, includes resident weights and input

plugin.activation: torch_npu.npu_swiglu, gate followed by up along the last axis

quantization.method: per-output-channel symmetric absmax, stored scale = BF16(max(abs(W))/127)
quantization.weight_quantization_scale: stored BF16 scale promoted to FP32 before division and rounding
quantization.rounding: torch.round, nearest with ties to even, clamp [-127,127]
quantization.weight_offset: zero; the pinned dynamic linear apply consumes weight_scale
quantization.down_scale_scope: full checkpoint K before TP input-column slicing

input_source.selection: first T rows of the flattened input for each token count
